sections.changelog:
Fixed

  • **A category name WordPress keeps encoded is no longer rewritten on every import.** A name such as «Провод <5мм» is stored by WordPress as `Провод <5мм`; the repair check compared it against its decoded form, which never matched, so the term was updated on every single run — an extra write and a term-cache flush each time, with no actual change to the data. The check now asks the only question that matters: would saving the cleaned name change what is already stored.
  • **Control bytes in a price list no longer eat the surrounding description.** Bytes `0x01`/`0x02` arriving verbatim from a feed were mistaken for the placeholders used internally to protect real markup, turned into angle brackets, and took the text between them with them. They are now dropped up front, along with the other meaningless characters.
  • **The column-detection error message is escaped before it reaches the page.** It was the only status message in the admin script rendered without escaping.
  • **Six log and notice messages are shown in Russian again.** Four had never been translated, and two lost their translation when their English wording was reworded in the code — among them the warning about a truncated feed and the report on stock zeroed for products that left the feed.
